card designsystematic issues i just want to start by saying theres a lot i love about this game your champ levels up your material decisions matter and the midgametoendgame shift is one of the coolest this is my character getting stronger feelings in any tcg the material deck is a huge part of that too its not just consistency its pacing and planning the problem is that the card pool and the incentives it creates keeps collapsing toward the same axis race to level 3 or sometimes level 10 then repeatedly find the handful of cards that either bury the opponent in advantage or just kill them and once that becomes the baseline assumption a lot of otherwise interesting designs dont get to exist they either become unplayable because theyre too slow or they get pushed into being strict upgrades in the same efficiency package dungeon guide is the poster child for how warped the race has gotten dungeon guide is a really clean example because it doesnt just help you level it tilts the whole gameplan toward sprinting in a ton of level3centric lists its basically the best way to convert early resources into skipping the tempo valve thats supposed to make leveling a meaningful trade when you stick it first the game often feels like it swings heavily in your direction youre ahead on development and youve compressed the window where the opponent can punish you for taking time to level and that creates a bigger why question if level 2 is mostly a hallway you run through whats the point of printing level 2 champions as interesting gameplay pieces in theory level 2 should be a distinct stage where decks express identity youre online enough to do your thing but not at the point where youre just chaining capstones in practice the incentive is often get through it asap so level 2 becomes less about decisionmaking and more about optimizing the shortest path to 3 i really think this card should be banned but it might also a necessary evil at the moment the consistency package makes decks feel samey even new ones this is the part that makes formats start to blur together a lot of decks end up running a critical mass of cards that are some mix of replace themselves smooth draws or have floating memory plus a small number of cards that are actually the reason the deck wins when thats the meta shape deckbuilding stops being based around building an identity around a champion and becomes how do i abuse this broken 2card combo it also makes new set releases trend toward upgrades instead of new play patterns if the baseline expectation is that youre racing and digging then the bar for a new card isnt does this enable a different line its is this more efficient than what i already run the result is that the card pool grows but deck texture doesnt diversify at the same rate because the incentives keep dragging lists back toward the same glue cards and you can see the downstream effect of that in what actually becomes playable as a new deck if youre not doing something that keeps pace with the damage race you basically dont get to exist because youll spend too long paying the levelup tax and then die to someone whos already presenting lethal pressure or inevitability obulation ciel and water diana are able to output crazy amounts of damage for pretty minimal setupcommitment also why can they just do it all at fast speed advanced element cards are structurally forced to be ridiculous and that feeds the same loop i think this is a big underdiscussed pressure point the reality is if a card is advanced element locked behind level 3 access in most lineages its competing with two huge problems at once first its often dead for a meaningful portion of the game second getting to level 3 is expensive in practice not mana expensive but i just burned a chunk of my future hand to get here expensive and a lot of advanced element cards arent worth that cost so what does that do to design space it means advanced element cards have to be so powerful that they pay you back for 1 being unavailable earlier and 2 the real resource bleed of leveling but once you print advanced payoffs that are worth it youve just reinforced the best reason to sprint to level 3 and then were back to the same meta shape maximize velocity maximize consistency hit the level 3 breakpoint slam haymakers combat rules squeeze allies into damage now or value now the other big limiter is combat texture because allies basically have natural haste and because units are so interactable the moment they hit the table the kinds of allies that survive the metagame tend to fall into two buckets they either push damage immediately or they generate value immediately anything that needs to live a turn to matter is inherently fighting uphill unless its overstatted selfprotecting or already refunded value thats a design straitjacket it makes it hard to print allies that are interesting for reasons other than this hits hard right now or this paid me the moment it entereddied and it pushes gameplay toward a lot of turns that are basically some variant of clear the board or race face because theres less room for slower positional pieces to exist safely theres also a pacing side effect when everything can immediately attack and the board is always live in multiple directions decision trees explode even fast decks can generate long turns because there are so many possible attacks trades and sequencing lines to evaluate every time you play a body a combat rules tweak could massively widen design space if you want healthier cards and more variety i genuinely think combat rules are one of the best levers you could pull removing natural haste summoning sickness by default would immediately give designers permission to print allies that matter over time without needing them to be polarizing the attack only rested allies direction is even more interesting because it makes combat committal youre choosing when you expose units and when you keep them safe which creates actual tension beyond can i push damage can i snipe your thing that kind of change doesnt just nerf a couple of aggressive lines it creates room for different classes of allies to exist engines that you can answer through combat defensive anchors that actually anchor and midrange boards that arent instantly reduced to whoever drew the better immediatevalue bodies three design directions id love to see explored first advanced element access at level 2 with the truly cracked advanced cards gated to level 3 this would make the power curve feel smoother and more expressive youd get to play real advancedelement cards as part of the midgame identity and level 3 could be reserved for capstones instead of being the moment your deck finally turns on second limit generic advantage without class bonus without board commitment the more the best drawselection tools are generic and nonboard the more decks converge if advantage has to live on the board more often you create healthier interaction and more meaningful investments it also makes class identity matter instead of everyone stapling the same smoothing package third stricter standards for oneshot finishers i dont think finishers are bad i think lowcommitmenteasy access finishers are bad spirit blade ensoul is a good model of the type of closer that feels healthy real deckbuilding requirement usually a meaningful commitment slow enough to interact with powerful but not a zerogame button more payoffs like that would keep the game explosive while still letting opponents meaningfully play thanks for coming to my ted talk none of this is a ga is doomed post its the opposite the systems are strong enough that the current incentive loop feels like a waste of potential and id love to see this game thrive interested to hear other peoples thoughts

space exploration is the physical investigation of outer space by uncrewed robotic space probes and through human spaceflight while the observation of objects in space known as astronomy predates reliable recorded history it was the development of large and relatively efficient rockets during the midtwentieth century that allowed physical space exploration to become a reality common rationales for exploring space include advancing scientific research national prestige uniting different nations ensuring the future survival of humanity and developing military and strategic advantages against other countries the early era of space exploration was driven by a space race in which the soviet union and the united states vied to demonstrate their technological superiority landmarks of this era include the launch of the first humanmade object to orbit earth the soviet unions sputnik 1 on 4 october 1957 and the first moon landing by the american apollo 11 mission on 20 july 1969 the soviet space program achieved many of the first milestones including the first living being in orbit in 1957 the first human spaceflight yuri gagarin aboard vostok 1 in 1961 the first spacewalk by alexei leonov on 18 march 1965 the first automatic landing on another celestial body in 1966 and the launch of the first space station salyut 1 in 1971 in the 1970s focus shifted from oneoff flights to renewable hardware such as the space shuttle program and from competition to cooperation the foremost example being the international space station iss built between 1998 and 2011 the 2000s brought advancements in the national spaceexploration programs of china the european union japan and india the 2010s saw the rise of the private space industry in earnest with the development of private launch vehicles space capsules and satellite manufacturing in the 2020s the two primary global programs gaining traction are moonfocused the chineseled international lunar research station and the usled artemis program with its plan to build the lunar gateway and the artemis base camp each with a set of international partners history of exploration first telescopes the first telescope is said to have been invented in 1608 in the netherlands by an eyeglass maker named hans lippershey but their first recorded use in astronomy was by galileo galilei in 1609 in 1668 isaac newton built his own reflecting telescope the first fully functional telescope of this kind and a landmark for future developments due to its superior features over the previous galilean telescope a string of discoveries in the solar system and beyond followed then and in the next centuries the mountains of the moon the phases of venus the main satellites of jupiter and saturn the rings of saturn many comets the asteroids the new planets uranus and neptune and many more satellites the orbiting astronomical observatory 2 was the first space telescope launched 1968 but the launch of the hubble space telescope in 1990 set a milestone as of 1 december 2022 there were 5284 confirmed exoplanets discovered the milky way is estimated to contain 100400 billion stars and more than 100 billion planets there are at least 2 trillion galaxies in the observable universe hd1 is the most distant known object from earth reported as 334 billion lightyears away first outer space flights mw 18014 was a german v2 rocket test launch that took place on 20 june 1944 at the peenemnde army research center in peenemnde it was the first humanmade object to reach outer space attaining an apogee of 176 kilometers which is well above the krmn line it was a vertical test launch although the rocket reached space it did not reach orbital velocity and therefore returned to earth in an impact becoming the first suborbital had two radio transmitters 20 and 40 mhz which emitted beeps that could be heard by radios around the globe analysis of the radio signals was used to gather information about the electron density of the ionosphere while temperature and pressure data were encoded in the duration of radio beeps the results indicated that the satellite was not punctured by a meteoroid sputnik 1 was launched by an r7
